work.composition: yellow frame around blank centre, target columns
work.description: Vertical mixed-media composition centered on a white rectangular void bordered by an ochre ground, with bilateral columns of concentric bullseye targets and gold compact discs flanking the central panel. Top-plan line drawing of a propeller aircraft appears above; a wooden chess bishop occupies the lower left corner alongside a black-and-white photographic fragment and handwritten text.
work.title: Yellow Frame, Blank Page
